1.1: Shammay omer, kol hannashim dayyan sheatan. vehillel omer, mippekida lifkida, afillu leyamim harebe. vachachamim omrim, lo chedivre ze velo chedivre ze, ella meet leet memaetet al yad mippekida lifkida, umippekida lifkida memaetet al yad meet leet. kol ishsha sheyyesh lah veset, dayyah sheatah. hameshammeshet beiddim, hare zo chifkida, memaetet al yad meet leet veal yad mippekida lifkida:
1.2: Shammay omer, mikkav lechalla. vehillel omer, mikkabbayim. vachachamim omrim, lo chedivre ze velo chedivre ze, ella kav umechetza chayyavim bechalla. umishshehigdilu hammiddot amru, chameshet revaim chayyavin. rabbi yose omer, chamishsha, peturin. chamishsha vaod, chayyavin:
1.3: Hillel omer, melo hin mayim sheuvin poslin et hammikve, ella sheadam chayyav lomar bilshon rabbo. veshammay omer, tisha kabbin. vachachamim omrim, lo chedivre ze velo chedivre ze, ella ad shebbau shene gardiyyim mishshaar haashpot shebbirushalayim veheidu mishshum shemaya veavtalyon, sheloshet luggin mayim sheuvin poslin et hammikve, vekiyyemu chachamim et divrehem:
1.4: Velamma mazkirin et divre shammay vehillel levattala, lelammed laddorot habbaim shello yehe adam omed al devarav, shehare avot haolam lo amdu al divrehem:
1.5: Velamma mazkirin divre hayyachid ben hamerubbin, hoil veen halacha ella chedivre hamerubbin. sheim yire vet din et divre hayyachid veyismoch alav, sheen bet din yachol levattel divre vet din chavero ad sheyyihye gadol mimmennu vechachma uveminyan. haya gadol mimmennu vechachma aval lo veminyan, beminyan aval lo vechachma, eno yachol levattel devarav, ad sheyyihye gadol mimmennu vechachma uveminyan:
1.6: Amar rabbi yehuda, im ken lamma mazkirin divre hayyachid ben hamerubbin levattala. sheim yomar haadam kach ani mekubbal, yeamer lo, kedivre ish peloni shamata:
1.7: Bet shammay omrim, rova atzamot min haatzamim, ben mishshenayim ben mishshelosha. uvet hillel omrim, rova atzamot min haggeviyya, merov habbinyan o merov hamminyan. shammay omer, afillu meetzem echad:
1.8: Karshine teruma, bet shammay omrim, shorin veshafin betohora, umaachilin betuma. bet hillel omrim, shorin betohora, veshafin umaachilin betuma. shammay omer, yeachlu tzarid. rabbi akiva omer, kol maasehem betuma:
1.9: Happoret sela mimmeot maaser sheni, bet shammay omrim, bechol hassela maot, uvet hillel omrim, beshekel kesef uveshekel maot. rabbi meir omer, en mechallelin kesef uferot al hakkesef. vachachamim mattirin:
1.10: Happoret sela shel maaser sheni birushalayim, bet shammay omrim, bechol hassela maot, uvet hillel omrim, beshekel kesef uveshekel maot. haddanim lifne chachamim omrim, bishlosha dinarim kesef uvedinar maot. rabbi akiva omer, bishlosha dinarim kesef uvirviit kesef birviit maot. verabbi tarfon omer, arbaa aspere chasef. shammay omer, yannichenna vachanut veyochal kenegdah:
1.11: Kisse shel kalla shennittelu chippuyav, bet shammay metammein, uvet hillel metaharin. shammay omer, af malben shel kisse tame. kisse shekkevao vaareva, bet shammay metammein, uvet hillel metaharin. shammay omer, af heasuy bah:
1.12: Ellu devarim shechazru vet hillel lehorot kedivre vet shammay. haishsha shebbaa mimmedinat hayyam veamra met bali, tinnase. met bali, tityabbem. uvet hillel omrim, lo shamanu ella bevaa min hakkatzir bilvad. amru lahem bet shammay, achat habbaa min hakkatzir veachat habbaa min hazzetim veachat habbaa mimmedinat hayyam, lo dibberu vakkatzir ella vahove. chazru vet hillel lehorot kevet shammay. bet shammay omrim, tinnase vetittol ketubbatah. uvet hillel omrim, tinnase velo tittol ketubbatah. amru lahem bet shammay, hittartem et haerva hachamura, lo tattiru et hammamon hakkal. amru lahem bet hillel, matzinu sheen haachim nichnasin lannachala al piha. amru lahem bet shammay, vahalo missefer ketubbatah nilmod, shehu chotev lah, sheim tinnasi leacher, titteli ma shekkatuv lich. chazru vet hillel lehorot kedivre vet shammay:
1.13: Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin, oved et rabbo yom echad veet atzmo yom echad, divre vet hillel. amru lahem bet shammay, tikkantem et rabbo, veet atzmo lo tikkantem. lissa shifcha, eno yachol. bat chorin, eno yachol. libbatel, vahalo lo nivra haolam ella lifriyya ureviyya, shenneemar (yeshaya ma), lo tohu veraah lashevet yetzarah. ella, mippene tikkun haolam, kofin et rabbo veose oto ven chorin vechotev shetar al chatzi damav. chazru vet hillel lehorot kevet shammay:
1.14: Keli cheres matztzil al hakkol, kedivre vet hillel. uvet shammay omrim, eno matztzil ella al hoochalin veal hammashkin veal kele chares. amru lahem bet hillel, mippene ma. amru lahem bet shammay, mippene shehu tame al gav am haaretz, veen keli tame chotzetz. amru lahem bet hillel, vahalo tihartem ochalim umashkin shebbetocho. amru lahem bet shammay, keshettiharnu ochalim umashkin shebbetocho, leatzmo tiharnu. aval keshettiharta et hakkeli, tiharta lecha valo. chazru vet hillel lehorot kedivre vet shammay:

2.1: Rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim heid arbaa devarim. mimehem shel kohanim lo nimneu millisrof et habbasar shennitma bivlad hattuma im habbasar shennitma beav hattuma, af al pi shemmosifin tuma al tumato. hosif rabbi akiva, mimehem shel kohanim lo nimneu millehadlik et hashshemen shennifsal bitvul yom bener shennitma vitme met, af al pi shemmosifin tuma al tumato:
2.2: Amar rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim, miyyamay lo raiti or yotze levet hasserefa. amar rabbi akiva, middevarav lamadnu, shehammafshit et habbechor venimtza terefa, sheyyeotu hakkohanim beoro. vachachamim omrim, lo rainu eno reaya, ella yotze levet hasserefa:
2.3: Af hu heid al kefar katan shehaya vetzad yerushalayim, vehaya vo zaken echad vehaya malve lechol bene hakkefar vechotev bichtav yado vaacherim chotmim, uva maase lifne chachamim vehittiru. lefi darkecha atta lamed, shehaishsha kotevet et gittah vehaish kotev et shovro, sheen kiyyum hagget ella vechotmav. veal machat shennimtzet babbasar, shehassakkin vehayyadayim tehorot, vehabbasar tame. veim nimtzet bapperesh, hakkol tahor:
2.4: Shelosha devarim amar rabbi yishmael lifne chachamim bakkerem beyavne. al betza terufa shehi netuna al gabbe yarak shel teruma, shehi chibbur. veim hayta chemin kova, enah chibbur. veal shibbolet shebbakkatzir veroshah maggia lakkama, im niktzera im hakkama, hare hi shel baal habbayit, veim lav, hare hi shel aniyyim. veal ginna ketanna shehi mukkefet aris, im yesh bah kimlo votzer vesallo mikkan umelo votzer vesallo mikkan, tizzarea. veim lav, lo tizzarea:
2.5: Shelosha devarim amru lifne rabbi yishmael, velo amar bahem lo issur vehetter, ufershan rabbi yehoshua ben matya. hammefis mursa beshabbat, im laasot lah pe, chayyav, veim lehotzi mimmenna lecha, patur. veal hatztzad nachash bashshabbat, im mitassek shello yishshechennu, patur, veim lirfua, chayyav. veal lefasin ironiyyot, shehem tehorot beohel hammet utemeot bemassa hazzav. rabbi elazar ben tzadok omer, af bemassa hazzav, tehorot, mippene shello nigmera melachtan:
2.6: Shelosha devarim amar rabbi yishmael velo hoda lo rabbi akiva. hashshum vehabboser vehammelilot sherissekan mibbeod yom, sherabbi yishmael omer, yigmor mishshettechshach, verabbi akiva omer, lo yigmor:
2.7: Shelosha devarim amru lifne rabbi akiva, shenayim mishshum rabbi eliezer veechad mishshum rabbi yehoshua. shenayim mishshum rabbi eliezer, yotzet ishsha veir shel zahav, umafriche yonim pesulim leedut. veechad mishshum rabbi yehoshua, hashsheretz befi chulda umehallechet al gabbe chikkarot shel teruma, safek naga safek lo naga, sefeko tahor:
2.8: Shelosha devarim amar rabbi akiva, al shenayim hodu lo veal echad lo hodu lo. al sandal shel sayyadim, shehu tame midras. veal sheyare tannur arbaa, shehayu omrim shelosha. vehodu lo. veal echad lo hodu lo, al kisse shennittelu shenayim mechippuyav ze betzad ze, sherabbi akiva metamme vachachamim metaharin:
2.9: Hu haya omer, haav zoche labben, bannoy, uvakkoach, uvaosher, uvachachma, uvashshanim, uvemispar haddorot lefanav, vehu hakketz, shenneemar (yeshaya ma) kore haddorot merosh, af al pi shenneemar (Bereshit 15), vaavadum veinnu otam arba meot shana, veneemar (sham), vedor revii yashuvu henna:
2.10: Af hu haya omer, chamishsha devarim shel shenem asar chodesh. mishpat dor hammabbul, shenem asar chodesh. mishpat iyyov, shenem asar chodesh. mishpat hammitzriyyim, shenem asar chodesh. mishpat gog umagog leatid lavo, shenem asar chodesh. mishpat reshaim begehinnom, shenem asar chodesh, shenneemar (yeshaya 66), vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, min happesach vead haatzeret, shenneemar umidde shabbat beshabbatto:

3.1: Kol hametammein beohel shennechleku, vehichnisan letoch habbayit, rabbi dosa ben harekinas metaher, vachachamim metammein. ketzad. hannogea bechishne chatzae zetim min hannevela o nosan, uvammet, hannogea bechachatzi zayit umaahil al kachatzi zayit o nogea bechachatzi zayit vechachatzi zayit maahil alav, umaahil al kishne chatzae zetim, maahil al kachatzi zayit vechachatzi zayit maahil alav, rabbi dosa ben harekinas metaher vachachamim metammein. aval hannogea bechachatzi zayit vedavar acher maahil alav veal kachatzi zayit, o maahil al kachatzi zayit vedavar acher maahil alav veal kachatzi zayit, tahor. amar rabbi meir, af baze rabbi dosa metaher vachachamim metammein. hakkol tame, chutz min hammagga im hammassa, vehammassa im haohel. ze hakkelal, kol shehu mishshem echad, tame. mishshene shemot, tahor:
3.2: Ochel parud, eno mitztaref, divre rabbi dosa ben harekinas. vachachamim omrim, mitztaref. mechallelin maaser sheni al asimon, divre rabbi dosa. vachachamim omrim, en mechallelin. matbilin yadayim lachattat, divre rabbi dosa. vachachamim omrim, im nitmeu yadav, nitma gufo:
3.3: Mee avattiach ukenivat yarak shel teruma, rabbi dosa mattir lezarim, vachachamim osrin. chamesh rechelot gezuzot mane mane uferas, chayyavot bereshit haggez, divre rabbi dosa. vachachamim omrim, chamesh rechelot kol shehen:
3.4: Kol hachotzalot temeot teme met, divre rabbi dosa. vachachamim omrim, midras. kol hakkeliot tehorot, chutz mishshel galgilon, divre rabbi dosa. vachachamim omrim, kullam temeot, chutz mishshel tzammarim:
3.5: Hakkela shebbet kibbul shellah arug, temea. veshel or, rabbi dosa ben harekinas metaher vachachamim metammein. nifsak bet etzba shellah, tehora. bet happakia shellah, temea:
3.6: Hashshevuya ochelet batteruma, divre rabbi dosa. vachachamim omrim, yesh shevuya ochelet veyesh shevuya sheenah ochelet. ketzad. haishsha sheamra nishbeti utehora ani, ochelet, shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. veim yesh edim shennishbet, vehi omeret tehora ani, enah ochelet:
3.7: Arbaa sefekot rabbi yehoshua metamme, vachachamim metaharin. ketzad. hattame omed vehattahor over, hattahor omed vehattame over, tuma birshut hayyachid vetohora birshut harabbim, tohora birshut hayyachid vetuma birshut harabbim, safek naga safek lo naga, safek heehil safek lo heehil, safek hesit safek lo hesit, rabbi yehoshua metamme, vachachamim metaharin:
3.8: Shelosha devarim rabbi tzadok metamme, vachachamim metaharin. masmer hashshulchani, vearon shel garosot, umasmer shel even shaot, rabbi tzadok metamme vachachamim metaharin:
3.9: Arbaa devarim rabban gamliel metamme, vachachamim metaharin. kissuy teni shel mattachot shel baale vattim, uteloy hammagredot, vegalme chele mattachot, vetavla shennechleka lishnayim. umodim chachamim lerabban gamliel betavla shennechleka lishnayim, echad gadol veechad katan, haggadol tame vehakkatan tahor:
3.10: Shelosha devarim rabban gamliel machmir kedivre vet shammay. en tomnin et hachammin miyyom tov leshabbat, veen zokfin et hammenora beyom tov, veen ofin pittin geritzin ella rekikin. amar rabban gamliel, mimehen shel bet abba lo hayu ofin pittin geritzin ella rekikin. amru lo, ma naase levet avicha shehayu machmirin al atzman umekillin al yisrael lihyot ofin pittin geritzin vachori:
3.11: Af hu amar shelosha devarim lehakel. mechabbedin ben hammittot, umenichin et hammugmar beyom tov, veosim gedi mekullas belele fesachim. vachachamim osrim:
3.12: Shelosha devarim rabbi elazar ben azarya mattir, vachachamim osrin. parato yotza virtzua shebben karneha, umekardin et habbehema beyom tov, veshochakin et happilpelin barechayim shellahen. rabbi yehuda omer, en mekardin et habbehema beyom tov, mippene shehu ose chabbura, aval mekartzefin. vachachamim omrim, en mekardin af lo mekartzefin:

4.1: Ellu devarim mikkulle vet shammay umechumre vet hillel. betza shennolda veyom tov, bet shammay omrim, teachel. uvet hillel omrim, lo teachel. bet shammay omrim, seor bechazzayit vechametz bechakkotevet. uvet hillel omrim, ze vaze bechazzayit:
4.2: Behema shennolda veyom tov, hakkol modim shehi mutteret. veefroach sheyyatza min habbetza, hakkol modim shehu asur. hashshochet chayya vaof beyom tov, bet shammay omrim, yachpor baddeker vichasse. uvet hillel omrim, lo yishchot ella im ken haya lo afar muchan. umodim sheim shachat, sheyyachpor baddeker vichasse. sheefer kira muchan hu:
4.3: Bet shammay omrim, hevker laaniyyim, hevker. uvet hillel omrim, eno hevker, ad sheyyuvkar af laashirim kashshemitta. kol amre hassade shel kav kav, veechad shel arbaa kabbin, ushechacho, bet shammay omrim, eno shichcha. uvet hillel omrim, shichcha:
4.4: Haomer shehu samuch laggappa velaggadish velabbakar velakkelim, ushechacho, bet shammay omrim, eno shichcha. uvet hillel omrim, shichcha:
4.5: Kerem revai, bet shammay omrim, en lo chomesh veen lo viur. uvet hillel omrim, yesh lo chomesh veyesh lo viur. bet shammay omrim, yesh lo feret veyesh lo ollot, vehaaniyyim podim leatzman. uvet hillel omrim, kullo laggat:
4.6: Chavit shel zetim megulgalim, bet shammay omrim, eno tzarich lenakkev. uvet hillel omrim, tzarich lenakkev. umodim, sheim nikkevah usetamuha shemarim, shehi tehora. hassach beshemen tahor venitma, yarad vetaval, bet shammay omrim, af al pi shehu menattef, tahor. uvet hillel omrim, kede sichat ever katan. veim haya shemen tame mittechillato, bet shammay omrim, kede sichat ever katan. uvet hillel omrim, mashke tofeach. rabbi yehuda omer mishshum bet hillel, tofeach umatpiach:
4.7: Haishsha mitkaddeshet bedinar uveshave dinar, kedivre vet shammay. uvet hillel omrim, bifruta uveshave feruta. vechamma hi feruta, echad mishshemona veissar haitalki. bet shammay omrim, poter hu et ishto veget yashan, uvet hillel osrin. ezehu get yashan. kol shennityached immah achar shekketavo lah. hamegaresh et ishto velana immo vefundeki, bet shammay omrim, enah tzericha mimmennu get sheni. uvet hillel omrim, tzericha mimmennu get sheni. ematay, bizman shennitgarsha min hannissuin. aval im nitgarsha min haerusin, enah tzericha mimmennu get sheni, mippene sheen libbo gas bah:
4.8: Bet shammay mattirin et hatztzarot laachim, uvet hillel osrin. chaltzu, bet shammay poslin min hakkehunna, uvet hillel machshirin. nityabbemu, bet shammay machshirin, uvet hillel poslin. veaf al pi sheellu foslin veellu machshirin, lo nimneu vet shammay millissa nashim mibbet hillel, velo vet hillel millissa nashim mibbet shammay. vechol hattohorot vehattumot shehayu ellu metaharin veellu metammein, lo nimneu lihyot osim tohorot ellu al gav ellu:
4.9: Shelosha achim, shenayim mehem nesuim lishte achayot veechad mufne, met echad mibbaale achayot veasa vah mufne maamar, veachar kach met achiv hashsheni, bet shammay omrim, ishto immo, vehalla tetze mishshum achot ishsha. uvet hillel omrim, motzi et ishto beget vachalitza, veet eshet achiv bachalitza. zo hi sheamru, i lo al ishto vei lo al eshet achiv:
4.10: Hammaddir et ishto mittashmish hammitta, bet shammay omrim, shete shabbatot. uvet hillel omrim, shabbat echat. hammappelet leor shemonim veechad, bet shammay potrin min hakkarban, uvet hillel mechayyevin. sadin betzitzit, bet shammay potrin, uvet hillel mechayyevim. kalkalat hashshabbat, bet shammay potrin, uvet hillel mechayyevin:
4.11: Mi shennadar nezirut merubba vehishlim neziruto veachar kach ba laaretz, bet shammay omrim, nazir sheloshim yom. uvet hillel omrim, nazir battechilla. mi shehayu shete chitte edim meidot oto, ellu meidim shennadar shetayim veellu meidim shennadar chamesh, bet shammay omrim, nechleka haedut veen kan nezirut. uvet hillel omrim, yesh bichlal chamesh shetayim, sheyyihye nazir shetayim:
4.12: Adam shehu natun tachat hassedek, bet shammay omrim, eno mevi et hattuma. uvet hillel omrim, adam chalul hu, vehatztzad haelyon mevi et hattuma:

5.1: Rabbi yehuda omer, shishsha devarim mikkulle vet shammay umechumre vet hillel. dam nevelot, bet shammay metaharin, uvet hillel metammein. betzat hannevela, im yesh kayyotze vah nimkeret bashshuk, mutteret. veim lav, asura, kedivre vet shammay. uvet hillel osrin. umodim bevetzat terefa shehi asura, mippene sheggadla veissur. dam nachrit vedam tohora shel metzoraat, bet shammay metaharin. uvet hillel omrim, kerukkah uchememe ragleha. ochlin perot sheviit betova veshello vetova, kedivre vet shammay. uvet hillel omrim, en ochlim ella vetova. hachemet, bet shammay omrim, tzerura omedet. uvet hillel omrim, af al pi sheenah tzerura:
5.2: Rabbi yose omer, shishsha devarim mikkule vet shammay umechumre vet hillel. haof ole im haggevina al hashshulchan veeno neechol, kedivre vet shammay. uvet hillel omrim, eno ole veeno neechol. tormin zetim al shemen, vaanavim al yayin, kedivre vet shammay. uvet hillel omrim, en tormin. hazzorea arba ammot shebbakkerem, bet shammay omrim, kiddesh shura achat, uvet hillel omrim, kiddesh shete shurot. hammeisa, bet shammay potrin, uvet hillel mechayyevin. matbilin bechardalit, kedivre vet shammay. uvet hillel omrim, en matbilin. ger shennitgayyer arve fesachim, bet shammay omrim, tovel veochel et pischo laerev. uvet hillel omrim, happoresh min haarla, keforesh min hakkaver:
5.3: Rabbi yishmael omer, shelosha devarim mikkulle vet shammay umechumre vet hillel. kohelet eno metamme et hayyadayim, kedivre vet shammay. uvet hillel omrim, metamme et hayyadayim. me chattat sheasu mitzvatan, bet shammay metaharin, uvet hillel metammein. hakketzach, bet shammay metaharin uvet hillel metammein. vechen lammaasrot:
5.4: Rabbi eliezer omer, shene devarim mikkulle vet shammay umechumre vet hillel. dam yoledet shello tavla, bet shammay omrim, kerukkah uchememe ragleha. uvet hillel omrim, metamme lach veyavesh. umodim beyoledet bezov shehu metamme lach veyavesh:
5.5: Arbaa achim, shenayim mehem nesuin shete achayot, metu hannesuim laachayot, hare ellu choltzot velo mityabbemot. veim kadmu vechansu, yotziu. rabbi eliezer omer mishshum bet shammay, yekayyemu. uvet hillel omrim, yotziu:
5.6: Akavya ben mahalalel heid arbaa devarim. amru lo, akavya, chazor becha vearbaa devarim shehayita omer venaascha av bet din leyisrael. amar lahen, mutav li lehikkare shote kol yamay, velo leasot shaa achat rasha lifne hammakom, shello yihyu omrim, bishvil serara chazar bo. hu haya metamme sear happekudda vedam hayyarok. vachachamim metaharin. hu haya mattir sear bechor baal mum shennashar vehinnicho vechallon veachar kach shechato, vachachamim osrim. hu haya omer, en mashkin lo et haggiyyoret velo et shifcha hameshuchreret. vachachamim omrim, mashkin. amru lo, maase becharkemit, shifcha meshuchreret shehayta virushalayim, vehishkuha shemaya veavtalyon. amar lahem, dugma hishkuha. venidduhu, umet benidduyo, vesaklu vet din et arono. amar rabbi yehuda, chas veshalom sheakavya nitnadda, sheen azara ninelet bifne chol adam miyyisrael bechachma uveyirat chet kaakavya ben mahalalel. veet mi niddu, eliezer ben chanoch, sheppikpek betohorat yadayim. ucheshemmet, shalchu vet din vehinnichu even al arono. melammed shekkol hammitnadde umet benidduyo, soklin et arono:
5.7: Bishat mitato amar livno, beni, chazor becha vearbaa devarim shehayiti omer. amar lo, velamma lo chazarta bach. amar lo, ani shamati mippi hamerubbim, vehem shamu mippi hamerubbim. ani amadti vishmuati, vehem amdu vishmuatan. aval atta shamata mippi hayyachid, umippi hamerubbin. mutav lehanniach divre hayyachid, veleechoz bedivre hamerubbin. amar lo, abba, pekod alay lachaverecha. amar lo, eni mafkid. amar lo, shemma ila matzata vi. amar lo, lav. maasecha yekarvucha umaasecha yerachakucha:

6.1: Rabbi yehuda ben bava heid chamishsha devarim. shemmemaanim et hakketannot, veshemmassiin et haishsha al pi ed echad, veshenniskal tarnegol birushalayim al sheharag et hannefesh, veal hayyayin ben arbaim yom shennitnassech al gav hammizbeach, veal tamid shel shachar shekkarav bearba shaot:
6.2: Heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi nechuneya ben elinatan ish kefar habbavli, al ever min hammet shehu tame, sherabbi eliezer omer, lo amru ella al ever min hachay. amru lo, vahalo kal vachomer. uma min hachay shehu tahor, ever happoresh mimmennu tame, hammet shehu tame, eno din sheyyihye ever happoresh mimmennu tame. amar lahem, lo amru ella al ever min hachay. davar acher, merubba tumat hachayyim mittumat hammetim, shehachay ose mishkav umoshav mittachtav, letamme adam uletamme vegadim, veal gabbav maddaf letamme ochalim umashkin, ma sheen hammet metamme:
6.3: Kazzayit basar happoresh meevar min hachay, rabbi eliezer metamme, verabbi yehoshua verabbi nechuneya metaharim. etzem kasseora happoresh meevar min hachay, rabbi nechuneya metamme, verabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua metaharin. amru lo lerabbi eliezer, ma raita letamme chazzayit basar happoresh meevar min hachay. amar lahem, matzinu ever min hachay kemet shalem. ma hammet, kazzayit basar happoresh mimmennu tame, af ever min hachay, kazzayit basar happoresh mimmennu yihye tame. amru lo, lo, im timmeta chazzayit basar happoresh min hammet, shekken timmeta etzem kasseora happoresh mimmennu, tetamme chazzayit basar happoresh meevar min hachay, shekken tiharta etzem kasseora happoresh hemennu. amru lo lerabbi nechuneya, ma raita letamme etzem kasseora happoresh meevar min hachay. amar lahem, matzinu ever min hachay kemet shalem. ma hammet, etzem kasseora happoresh mimmennu tame, af ever min hachay, etzem kasseora happoresh mimmennu yihye tame. amru lo, lo, im timmeta etzem kasseora happoresh min hammet, shekken timmeta chazzayit basar happoresh mimmennu, tetamme etzem kasseora happoresh meevar min hachay, shekken tiharta chazzayit basar happoresh mimmennu. amru lo lerabbi eliezer, ma raita lachalok middotecha, o tamme vishnehem o taher bishnehem. amar lahem, merubba tumat habbasar mittumat haatzamot, shehabbasar noheg bannevelot uvashsheratzim, ma sheen ken baatzamot. davar acher, ever sheyyesh alav basar karauy, metamme vemagga uvemassa uveohel. chaser habbasar, tame. chaser haetzem, tahor. amru lo lerabbi nechuneya, ma raita lachalok middotecha, o tamme vishnehem o taher bishnehem. amar lahem, merubba tumat haatzamot mittumat habbasar, shehabbasar happoresh min hachay tahor, veevar happoresh mimmennu, vehu chivriyyato, tame. davar acher, kazzayit basar metamme vemagga uvemassa uveohel, verov atzamot metammeim bemagga uvemassa uveohel. chaser habbasar, tahor. chaser rov atzamot, af al pi shettahor milletamme veohel, metamme vemagga uvemassa. davar acher, kol besar hammet, shehu fachot mikkazzayit, tahor. rov binyano verov minyano shel met, af al pi sheen bahem rova, temein. amru lo lerabbi yehoshua, ma raita letaher bishnehem. amar lahem, lo, im amartem bammet, sheyyesh bo rov verova verakav, tomru vachay sheen bo rov verova verakav:

7.1: Heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi tzadok al pidyon peter chamor shemmet, sheen bo lakkohen kelum, sherabbi eliezer omer, chayyavin beacharayutan kechamesh selaim shel ben. vachachamim omrim, en chayyavin beacharayutan ella chefidyon shel maaser sheni:
7.2: Heid rabbi tzadok al tzir chagavim temeim, shehu tahor. shemmishna rishona, chagavim temeim shennichbeshu im chagavim tehorim, lo faslu tziran:
7.3: Heid rabbi tzadok al zochalin sherabbu al hannotfim, shehem kesherim. maase haya bevirat happilya, uva maase lifne chachamim vehichshiruhu:
7.4: Heid rabbi tzadok al zochalin shekkillechan baale egoz, shehen kesherim. maase haya veoholya, uva maase lifne lishkat haggazit, vehichshiruhu:
7.5: Heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi yakim ish hadar al kalal shel chattat shennetano al gabbe hashsheretz, shehu tame. sherabbi eliezer metaher. heid rabbi pappeyas al mi shennazar shete nezirut, sheim gillach et harishona yom sheloshim, shemmegalleach hashsheniyya yom shishshim. veim gillach yom shishshim chaser echad, yatza, sheyyom sheloshim ole lo min hamminyan:
7.6: Heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi pappeyas al valad shel shelamim, sheyyikrav shelamim. sherabbi eliezer omer shevvelad shelamim lo yikrav shelamim. vachachamim omrim, yikrav. amar rabbi pappeyas, ani meid shehayta lanu fara zivche shelamim, vaachalnuha vappesach veachalnu veladah shelamim bechag:
7.7: Hem heidu al aruchot shel nachtomim, shehen temeot. sherabbi eliezer metaher. hem heidu al tannur shechittecho chulyot venatan chol ben chulya lechulya, shehu tame. sherabbi eliezer metaher. hem heidu shemmeabberin et hashshana bechol adar. shehayu omrim ad happurim. hem heidu shemmeabberim et hashshana al tenay. umaase verabban gamliel shehalach littol reshut mehegmon besureya veshaha lavo, veibberu et hashshana al tenay lichsheyyirtze rabban gamliel, ucheshebba amar rotze ani, venimtzet hashshana meubbaret:
7.8: Heid menachem ben signay al musaf hayyora shel sholke zetim shehu tame, veshel tzabbaim shehu tahor. shehayu omrim chilluf haddevarim:
7.9: Heid rabbi nechuneya ven gudgeda al hachereshet shehissiah aviha, shehi yotza veget. veal ketanna vat yisrael shennisset lechohen, shehi ochelet batteruma, veim meta, balah yorshah. veal hammarish haggazul shebbenao vabbira, sheyyitten et damav. veal hachattat haggezula shello noda larabbim, shehi mechapperet, mippene tikkun hammizbeach:

8.1: Heid rabbi yehoshua ben betera al dam nevelot shehu tahor. heid rabbi shimon ben betera al efer chattat shennaga tame vemiktzato, shettimme et kullo. hosif rabbi akiva, al hassolet veal hakketoret vehallevona vehaggechalim shennaga tevul yom bemiktzatam, sheppasal et kullam:
8.2: Heid rabbi yehuda ven bava verabbi yehuda hakkohen al ketanna vat yisrael shennisset lechohen, shehi ochelet batteruma kevan shennichnesa lachuppa af al pi shello nivala. heid rabbi yose hakkohen verabbi zecharya ven hakkatztzav al tinoket shehurhana veashkelon, verichakuha vene mishpachtah, veedeha meidim otah shello nistera veshello nitmaa. amru lahem chachamim, im maaminim attem shehurhana, haaminu, shello nistera veshello nitmaa. veim en attem maaminim shello nistera veshello nitmea, al taaminu shehurhana:
8.3: Heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi yehuda ven betera al almanat issa, shehi cheshera lakkehunna, shehaissa cheshera letamme uletaher, lerachek ulekarev. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, kibbalnu edutechem, aval ma naase, sheggazar rabbi yochanan ben zakkay shello lehoshiv batte dinin al kach. hakkohanim shomim lachem lerachek, aval lo lekarev:
8.4: Heid rabbi yose ben yoezer, ish tzereda, al ayil kamtza, dachan. veal mashke vet mitbechayya, deinnun dachyan. udeyikrav bemita, mistaav. vekaru leh, yose sharya:
8.5: Heid rabbi akiva mishshum nechemya, ish bet deli, shemmassiim haishsha al pi ed echad. heid rabbi yehoshua al atzamot shennimtzeu vedir haetzim, amru chachamim, melakket etzem etzem vehakkol tahor:
8.6: Amar rabbi eliezer, shamati, keshehayu vonim bahechol, osim kelaim lahechol ukelaim laazarot, ella shebbahechol bonim mibbachutz, uvaazara bonim mibbifnim. amar rabbi yehoshua, shamati, shemmakrivin af al pi sheen bayit, veochlim kadshe kadashim af al pi sheen kelaim, kadashim kallim umaaser sheni, af al pi sheen choma, shekkedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah vekiddesha leatid lavo:
8.7: Amar rabbi yehoshua, mekubbal ani merabban yochanan ben zakkay, sheshshama merabbo verabbo merabbo, halacha lemoshe missinay, sheen eliyyahu va letamme uletaher, lerachek ulekarev, ella lerachek hamekoravin bizroa ulekarev hameruchakin bizroa. mishpachat bet tzerifa hayta veever hayyarden verichakah ben tziyyon bizroa, veod acheret hayta sham vekervah ben tziyyon bizroa. kegon ellu, eliyyahu va letamme uletaher, lerachek ulekarev. rabbi yehuda omer, lekarev, aval lo lerachek. rabbi shimon omer, lehashevot hammachaloket. vachachamim omrim, lo lerachek velo lekarev, ella laasot shalom baolam, shenneemar (Malachi 3) hinne anochi sholeach lachem et eliyya hannavi vegomer veheshiv lev avot al banim velev banim al avotam:
